submitted.rationale: XRD across the line showed that an extra phase, beyond the substrate reflections (reflections at Q≈1.05, 1.39, 1.45, 1.55, 1.80), is strongest near Nb:V≈1:1 (likely NbVO5). It is weaker at 0.46 and 0.58 Nb and gone at 0.71 Nb, where a different phase appears. Photocurrent was 6.26e-6 A at idx11 (Nb 0.505), 7.61e-6 A at idx10 (Nb 0.482) and negative at idx13 (Nb 0.714). Idx10 is the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Nb-rich end has a different phase with no 1:1 phase peaks; measured photocurrent was negative (-3.17e-6 A)
Measured 6.26e-6 A, which is lower than idx10
XRD shows a weaker 1:1 phase fraction than near Nb 0.5; not measured
